lines.text: Thinking Machines ships Inkling 2 Small; AA Index 31; Apache 2.0 weights planned next week
OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for Daybreak Red; Critical cyber under Preparedness Framework
AA now labels Kimi K3.1 Pro open-weights; Index still 46, leads AA open-source table

feed.headline: Thinking Machines ships Inkling 2 Small; AA Index 31; Apache 2.0 weights next week
feed.why: 594B MoE / 17B active, 1M context; Tinker now with closed weights. AA: would lead non-China open-weights once weights land.

feed.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for approved Daybreak Red security customers
feed.why: OpenAI reports ExploitGym 48.5% vs 32.1%, a Critical cyber class, 81 novel Firefox highs, and 948 Linux exploits.

feed.headline: AA now labels Kimi K3.1 Pro as open-weights; Index still 46
feed.why: Live AA page says open weights and links Hugging Face. It leads AA's open-source comparison. No Index rescore.

feed.headline: Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash GA: 15-second video, 30% cheaper
feed.why: Price is $0.07/sec at 720p, with multi-turn edits. API and Cloud GA. Outputs carry a SynthID watermark.

feed.headline: Anthropic rolls out Claude Personal Finance beta in the US
feed.why: Read-only Plaid bank links on Pro, Max, and Ultra. Cannot move or invest money. Hub chats are not used for training.

feed.headline: Mistral Studio adds Managed Agents, apps, and workflow builder
feed.why: Public preview dated 5 Nov. Python Agents SDK can run locally, self-hosted, or on Mistral, including durable background jobs.

feed.headline: Perplexity launches Teammates, persistent agents for ongoing work
feed.why: Always-on work agents. The Verge says Max-plan access and compares them to OpenAI Dots and Claude Duet.

feed.headline: AA scores Nanbeige4.3-33B at 20 on Intelligence Index v5
feed.why: Apache 2.0 dense 33B model matching Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh). Weights have been on Hugging Face since late October.
